errors.description: For coprime m,n, the second new entry is mn, not m+n. The subsequent replacement by (1,mn) and the termination argument are correct, so this is a readily repairable typo.

The final characterization is false as stated unless primes are restricted to those occurring initially: for an absent prime, any positive exponent divides all zero valuations, so no maximal d exists under the stated condition.
errors.quote: the unique maximal $d$ with $v_p(d) \mid v_p(a_i)$ for all $p$ and all $i$.

parsed.notes: The main termination and valuation-invariance proofs are otherwise rigorous and establish both requested conclusions. The errors are minor and do not undermine the core argument.
